title: Crescent
description:
Part vestment and part organism, Crescent captures the body in a state of ongoing mutation.

Material choices and lunar symbolism converge in a layered structure: a rigid, translucent outer shell encloses a soft inner matter, revealing a second form contained beneath the surface.

The resulting tension between containment and emergence gives physical form to opposing yet coexisting forces.

Realised in 3D-printed clear resin with silicone infill.

Model: HEZEN x Playbody
